# Copilot Instructions — Porcupine Cross

The project instructions live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository
root. Read that file first; it is the single source of truth for stack,
commands, CSS cascade rules and architecture constraints.

This file is deliberately a pointer. Duplicating the content here would let the
two copies drift apart, which is what happened with the Cursor rules file that
this setup replaced.
